title: Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Amendment Act 1996

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVI OF 1996
ACT XVI OF 1996
KARACHI FISHERIES HARBOUR AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the Karachi
Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1984
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th July, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-10/96.---The
Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 13th June, 1996 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 8th July, 1996 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority (Amendment) Act, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Amendment Act 1996
sections.description:
Amendment of section 6 of Sindh Ordinance II of 1984

ACT XVI OF 1996
ACT XVI OF 1996
KARACHI FISHERIES HARBOUR AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1996
An Act to amend the Karachi
Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1984
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th July, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-10/96.---The
Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1996 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 13th June, 1996 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 8th July, 1996 is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 6 of Sindh Ordinance II of 1984.--- In the
Karachi Fisheries Harbour Authority Ordinance, 1984, in section 6, in
subsection (1), for clause (iii) including the proviso, the following shall be
substituted:--
(iii) five nominees of the
society;
(iv) one representative of the
fish processing industry appointed by Government;
Provided that the number of
members including the Chairman shall not be less than fifteen".
